chunks: My father عليه السلام had a wife who used to harm him, yet he would forgive her.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, the Imam عليه السلام transmitting the statement
key_terms.أَبِي: my father, referring to the Imam's father عليه السلام
key_terms.امْرَأَةٌ: a wife or woman in a marital relationship
key_terms.تُؤْذِيهِ: she would harm or trouble him

ai.seo_question: How did the Imam عليه السلام respond to harm from his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the forbearance and forgiveness shown by the father of Abu Abdillah عليه السلام toward harm within the household. It highlights patience and pardoning in family relations as a mark of noble character.
